name: Comp Study Physios
description:
Comp Study Physios is a modern physiotherapy management mobile application developed in Flutter with a professional dark theme and yellow accent UI. The app helps clinics and physiotherapists efficiently manage patients, appointments, recovery progress, therapists, and treatment analytics in one centralized platform. It includes interactive dashboards, animated progress indicators, booking management, analytics graphs, patient records, and physiotherapist management features. The application is designed to improve workflow efficiency, track patient recovery performance, and provide a smooth digital healthcare management experience.

This app is mainly used by physiotherapy clinics, rehabilitation centers, hospitals, and independent physiotherapists to manage their daily operations digitally. Therapists can monitor patient recovery progress, manage appointments, and analyze treatment statistics through charts and dashboards. Administrative staff can maintain patient records and booking schedules efficiently, while clinic owners can use the analytics system to monitor overall performance and productivity.

name: Bible Path: Devocional Diario
description:
Bible Path é um aplicativo bíblia sagrada cuidadosamente desenvolvido para enriquecer sua jornada espiritual com escrituras que oferecem orientação e inspiração sagrada. Seja para buscar inspiração diária, reflexões devocionais ou um entendimento mais profundo das escrituras, o Bible Path proporciona um ambiente sereno para o seu crescimento pessoal.

**Principais Funcionalidades:**

**Widgets de Escrituras de Hora em Hora:**
Mantenha a Palavra de Deus constantemente diante dos seus olhos. Configure nosso novo **widget de versículos por hora** na sua tela inicial ou tela de bloqueio para ler um novo versículo bíblico a cada hora. Fique conectado com a Bíblia ao longo do dia sem precisar abrir o aplicativo.

**Histórias Bíblicas em Vídeo:**
Visualize o Evangelho com nossas novas animações de histórias bíblicas. Essas belas narrativas animadas dão vida à Bíblia, oferecendo uma nova maneira para famílias e pessoas que aprendem visualmente se envolverem com os relatos clássicos do Antigo e Novo Testamento.

**Bible Chat:**
Participe de conversas profundas sobre fé, orações e escrituras com o Bible Chat. Esta ferramenta permite explorar diferentes interpretações da Bíblia, fazer perguntas teológicas e encontrar clareza espiritual em um ambiente sagrado. A interface facilita o compartilhamento de pensamentos com uma comunidade de buscadores.

**Bíblia em Áudio e Orações:**
Mergulhe nas Sagradas Escrituras com nossa Bíblia em Áudio. Perfeita para momentos de reflexão ou durante seus trajetos diários, as escrituras narradas ajudam você a manter a conexão com Deus. Ouça orações em áudio e meditações guiadas para integrar o estudo devocional na sua rotina.

**Reflexões Diárias Personalizadas:**
Comece o seu dia com insights baseados nas escrituras sagradas que ressoam com suas necessidades espirituais. Essas reflexões são elaboradas para ajudar você a meditar em temas bíblicos e integrar seus ensinamentos na vida diária através de práticas devocionais consistentes.

**Estudos Bíblicos Interativos:**
Aprofunde sua compreensão da Bíblia com nossos guias de estudo interativos. Esses recursos fornecem insights e contexto abrangentes, sendo adequados tanto para estudos pessoais quanto para discussões em grupo, focando no enriquecimento da sua vida espiritual.

**Exercícios para Fortalecer a Fé:**
Participe de exercícios projetados para fortalecer sua fé e entendimento, complementados com orações poderosas. Essas atividades encorajam você a refletir sobre as escrituras e aplicá-las à sua vida, encontrando conforto e um significado mais profundo.

**Estudos e Recursos:**
Acesse uma ampla gama de materiais de estudo adaptados a diferentes níveis de conhecimento bíblico. Se você está apenas começando sua jornada ou buscando um entendimento avançado, o Bible Path oferece um recurso de apoio repleto de sabedoria e reflexões.

**Por que Escolher o Bible Path?**
O Bible Path é mais do que um aplicativo; é um companheiro espiritual. Com ferramentas como o Bible Chat, recursos de áudio, widgets por hora e histórias animadas, ele foi desenhado para ser um guia gentil, ajudando você a encontrar clareza e paz através das escrituras.

Baixe o Bible Path hoje mesmo. Comece uma jornada de reflexão, aprendizado e crescimento espiritual, guiado pela sabedoria, pela oração e pela Palavra de Deus.

name: Calendário Menstrual Flo
description:
O Flo é um calendário menstrual, um monitor de ovulação e um app de fertilidade e gravidez, criado para o acompanhamento do ciclo menstrual e usado por mais de 500 milhões de pessoas no mundo.* 

Com o Flo, você registra a menstruação, prevê a ovulação, aprende a identificar seus sinais de fertilidade e explora os sintomas da perimenopausa. Do planejamento da gravidez à gestação, o Flo acompanha sua saúde feminina em cada fase.

Meus dados estão seguros com o Flo?

Sim. O programa de Privacidade e Segurança do Flo é premiado, e o Flo é o primeiro aplicativo de acompanhamento do ciclo menstrual certificado tanto na ISO 27001 quanto na ISO 27701, os padrões internacionais de excelência em proteção de dados.

- Modo anônimo: use o Flo sem que sua identidade seja vinculada às suas informações de saúde. Ninguém, nem mesmo nós, pode identificar você.
- Criptografia em todas as camadas: os mesmos padrões usados por bancos e órgãos governamentais.
- Transparência: nosso Trust & Safety Hub e a página de Privacidade e Segurança no aplicativo reúnem, em um só lugar, todas as informações essenciais que você precisa.
- Liderança especializada: uma equipe de privacidade e segurança premiada, apoiada por um conselho consultivo independente de especialistas.

Por que escolher o Flo para acompanhar a menstruação e a ovulação?

- Mais que um calendário comum, este app de menstruação ajuda você a identificar os padrões do seu ciclo menstrual ao longo do tempo.
- Mais de 70 sintomas e humores para registrar, como cólica menstrual e secreção, com informações personalizadas
- Suporte para ciclos irregulares e atraso menstrual
- Resumos claros do que você registrou, para compartilhar com seu médico

O Flo pode me ajudar a me sentir informada sobre minha jornada de tentante (TTC)?

- O Flo oferece recursos educativos para você entender melhor seu ciclo menstrual e sua ovulação se você está tentando engravidar.
- Previsões da janela de ovulação, com base nos seus dados registrados
- Acompanhamento da temperatura corporal basal e do muco cervical

Como o Flo acompanha minha gravidez semana a semana?

- Após a concepção, use o Flo Gravidez para uma experiência estruturada, semana a semana.
- Monitor de gravidez semana a semana conforme seu bebê se desenvolve
- Imagens e diagramas que explicam as mudanças da gestação
- Conteúdo revisado por especialistas e histórias da comunidade

O Flo ajuda com os sintomas da perimenopausa?

- Acompanhe as mudanças dessa fase da vida com ferramentas dedicadas.
- Escore de Perimenopausa para explorar como os sintomas comuns podem afetar o dia a dia
- Fases da Menopausa para entender suas fases

O Flo é gratuito?

O Flo é gratuito para baixar, com todas as ferramentas essenciais para entender seu ciclo menstrual.

O que o Flo Premium oferece?

- Informações diárias personalizadas e vídeos de especialistas
- Recursos de gravidez detalhados para cada fase, com gestação semana a semana
- Diário menstrual para registrar a TPM e outros sintomas
- Lembretes para a pílula anticoncepcional e para a menstruação
- Educação e informações sobre fertilidade
- Assistente de Saúde virtual 24 horas para informações e conteúdo educativo sobre TPM, ciclos irregulares e muito mais
- Flo a Dois: compartilhe as previsões do seu ciclo ou o avanço da gravidez com seu parceiro

Aviso médico

O Flo não oferece orientação médica, diagnóstico ou tratamento, e não é um método contraceptivo nem uma ajuda para a concepção. Consulte sempre um profissional ou uma profissional de saúde qualificado(a).

Baixe o Flo e junte-se a milhões de pessoas que confiam neste calendário menstrual, neste app de gravidez e neste monitor do ciclo menstrual.

Política de privacidade: https://flo.health/pt/politica-de-privacidade

Termos de Uso: https://flo.health/pt/termos-de-uso

*Número total de usuárias que baixaram o Flo, julho de 2026

name: Google Drive - armazenamento
Cartão Pernambucanas
Microsoft Teams
description:
Esteja você se conectando com sua comunidade para uma atividade futura ou trabalhando com colegas de equipe em um projeto, o Microsoft Teams ajuda a reunir as pessoas para que elas possam realizar as coisas. É o único aplicativo que tem comunidades, eventos, chats, canais, reuniões, armazenamento, tarefas e calendários em um só lugar, para que você possa se conectar e gerenciar facilmente o acesso às informações. Reúna sua comunidade, família, amigos ou colegas de trabalho para realizar tarefas, compartilhar ideias e fazer planos. Participe de chamadas de áudio e vídeo em uma configuração segura, colabore em documentos e armazene arquivos e fotos com armazenamento na nuvem integrado. Você pode fazer tudo isso no Microsoft Teams. 

Conecte-se facilmente a qualquer pessoa: 
• O Skype agora faz parte do Teams. Continue de onde parou com seus chats, chamadas e contatos no Microsoft Teams Gratuito.
• Reúna-se com segurança com comunidades, colegas de equipe, familiares ou amigos.
• Configure uma reunião em poucos segundos e convide qualquer pessoa compartilhando um link ou um convite de calendário. 
• Converse individualmente ou com toda a sua comunidade, @mencione pessoas nos chats para chamar a atenção delas. 
• Crie uma comunidade dedicada para discutir tópicos específicos e fazer planos*.
• Trabalhe de perto e colabore, mantendo conversas organizadas por tópicos e projetos específicos com equipes e canais.
• Faça uma chamada de vídeo ou áudio para qualquer pessoa diretamente no Teams ou converta instantaneamente um chat em grupo em uma chamada. 
• Use GIFs, emojis e animações de mensagem para se expressar quando as palavras não são suficientes. 

Realize planos e projetos em conjunto: 
• Envie fotos e vídeos em chats para compartilhar de forma rápida e fácil momentos importantes.
• Use o armazenamento em nuvem para acessar documentos e arquivos compartilhados em qualquer lugar. 
• Organize o conteúdo compartilhado em uma comunidade, eventos, fotos, links, arquivos, para que você não tenha que perder tempo pesquisando*. 
• Tire o máximo proveito das suas reuniões usando o compartilhamento de tela, quadro de comunicações ou sessão de grupo em salas virtuais.
• Gerencie o acesso às informações e garanta que as pessoas certas tenham acesso às informações certas, mesmo quando as pessoas ingressarem e saírem dos projetos.
• Use listas de tarefas para ficar por dentro dos projetos e planos: atribua tarefas, defina datas de conclusão e risque itens para manter todos em sintonia. 

Projetado para lhe dar mais tranquilidade: 
• Colabore de forma segura com outras pessoas, mantendo o controle sobre seus dados.
• Mantenha as comunidades seguras, permitindo que os proprietários removam conteúdos ou membros inadequados *.
• Conte com a conformidade e a segurança de nível empresarial que você espera do Microsoft 365**. 

*Disponível ao usar o Microsoft Teams com a sua conta Microsoft.

**Os recursos comerciais deste aplicativo exigem uma assinatura comercial paga do Microsoft 365 ou uma assinatura de avaliação do Microsoft Teams para trabalho. Se não tiver certeza sobre a assinatura da sua empresa ou sobre os serviços aos quais você tem acesso, acesse Office.com/Teams para saber mais ou entre em contato com o departamento de TI. 

Ao baixar o Teams, você concorda com a licença (confira aka.ms/eulateamsmobile) e os termos de privacidade (confira aka.ms/privacy). Para obter suporte ou feedback, envia-nos um email para mtiosapp@microsoft.com. Resumo do Contrato da UE: aka.ms/EUContractSummary

name: Strava: corrida, pedal, trilha
description:
Vencedor do App Store Award - App do ano para Apple Watch

O Strava reune toda a sua vida esportiva em um só lugar – e você pode compartilhá-la com os amigos. Veja como:

• Grave todas as suas atividades: corridas, pedaladas, trilhas, ioga e mais de 50+ outros tipos de esportes. Pense no Strava como a biblioteca do seu movimento.

• Veja o panorama completo do seu treinamento de força — Musculação na academia toda semana, treinos de HIIT e aulas em grupo de treino com pesos? Use seu dispositivo ou app de força preferido, e seus exercícios, séries, repetições, pesos e um mapa muscular aparecerão automaticamente. Ou comece hoje sua jornada de força e veja como esses treinos rapidamente se tornam parte essencial da sua vida esportiva.

• Veja o panorama completo dos seus treinos de força. Treina no ginásio todas as semanas, faz sessões de HIIT ou participa em aulas de musculação em grupo? Utilize o seu dispositivo ou a sua aplicação de treino de força preferida e o Strava mostrará automaticamente os seus exercícios, séries, repetições, pesos e um mapa dos músculos trabalhados. Ou comece hoje mesmo a trabalhar a sua força e descubra como este tipo de treino pode rapidamente tornar-se uma parte essencial da sua vida ativa.

• Explore em qualquer lugar: nossa ferramenta de Rotas usa dados anonimizados do Strava para recomendar rotas populares de forma inteligente com base nas suas preferências. Você também pode construir seus próprios percursos.

• Construa uma rede de apoio: o Strava é sobre celebrar o movimento. Aqui você vai encontrar sua comunidade e torcer uns pelos outros.

• Treine de forma mais inteligente: receba dados avançados para entender seu progresso e ver como você está evoluindo. Seu Controle de Treinamento é o registro de todos os seus treinos.

• Mova-se com mais segurança: compartilhe sua localização em tempo real com amigos e familiares enquanto estiver se exercitando para ter mais segurança.

• Sincronize seus aplicativos e dispositivos preferidos: o Strava é compatível com milhares deles (Apple Watch, Fitbit, Garmin – você escolhe).

• Participe e crie desafios: junte-se a milhões em desafios mensais para atingir novas metas, coletar medalhas digitais e manter a motivação.

• A vida sem filtros: o seu feed no Strava está cheio de atividades reais de pessoas de verdade. É assim que motivamos uns aos outros.

• Seja você um atleta profissional ou um iniciante, o Strava é para você. É só continuar se movimentando e compartilhando suas atividades.

O Strava inclui uma versão gratuita e uma versão de assinatura com recursos premium.

O Strava usa o HealthKit para exportar suas atividades do Strava para o aplicativo Saúde e ler a frequência cardíaca e os dados biométricos.

Você pode fazer uma assinatura e o pagamento usando o seu ID Apple na App Store. O pagamento será cobrado no seu ID Apple na confirmação da compra. Sua assinatura será renovada automaticamente, a menos que seja cancelada pelo menos 24 horas antes do final do período atual. Sua conta será cobrada pela renovação dentro de 24 horas antes do final do período atual. As assinaturas podem ser gerenciadas pelo usuário e a renovação automática pode ser desativada após a compra acessando a página "Gerenciar assinatura" nas configurações. A parte não utilizada de um período de teste gratuito, caso oferecido, será perdida quando o usuário fizer uma assinatura. A assinatura será renovada pelo mesmo preço.

name: Discord - Converse e Jogue
description:
O Discord foi criado para jogos e é perfeito para apenas relaxar com amigos ou construir uma comunidade. Personalize seu próprio espaço e reúna seus amigos para falar enquanto joga seus jogos favoritos, ou apenas para passar o tempo.

BATE-PAPO EM GRUPO QUE É SÓ DIVERSÃO E JOGOS
∙ O Discord é excelente para jogar e relaxar com amigos, ou até mesmo para construir uma comunidade global. Personalize seu próprio espaço para falar, jogar e passar o tempo.

TORNE SEUS BATE-PAPOS EM GRUPO MAIS DIVERTIDOS
∙ Crie emojis personalizados, figurinhas, efeitos de painel de som e muito mais para adicionar sua personalidade ao bate-papo de voz, vídeo ou texto. Defina seu avatar, um status personalizado e escreva seu próprio perfil para se apresentar no bate-papo do seu jeito.

TRANSMITA COMO SE ESTIVESSE NA MESMA SALA
∙ A transmissão de alta qualidade e baixa latência faz com que você se sinta no sofá com seus amigos enquanto joga, assiste shows, olha fotos, ou, sei lá, faz o dever de casa ou algo do tipo.

ENTRE QUANDO ESTIVER LIVRE, NÃO PRECISA LIGAR

VEJA QUEM ESTÁ DISPONÍVEL PARA RELAXAR

name: Life360: Localização familiar
description:
O Life360 simplifica a vida, tornando mais fácil para você se manter conectado com as pessoas que mais importam – seu Círculo. Com o Compartilhamento de Localização, você pode:
  
- Ver facilmente a localização em tempo real de seus amigos e familiares no mapa.
- Receber Alertas de Locais quando seus entes queridos chegarem ou saírem de casa, do trabalho ou da escola.
- Compartilhar fotos e mensagens de texto com nosso recurso de chat seguro e privado.
- Conferir o Histórico de Localização do seu Círculo.
- Melhorar a segurança da condução com informações relevantes após cada viagem.
  
O localizador de amigos e familiares do Life360 utiliza dados de localização de GPS para monitorar em tempo real onde estão de seus amigos e familiares. Basta instalar o Life360 em cada celular. É um aplicativo compatível com a maiores plataformas móveis. Cada membro aparecerá como um ícone único no seu mapa, fazendo com que você sempre saiba onde seus entes queridos estão. Com o Life360, ficar informado sobre a localização de todos é fácil e confiável. 
  
 Preocupado se a bateria vai acabar? O Life360 tem o menor consumo de bateria de todos os aplicativos de localização no mercado. Nosso algoritmo avançado nos ajuda a decidir quando atualizar sua localização, para que seu GPS nunca fique ligado quando não é preciso. 
  
Aproveite estes recursos importantes ao se registrar no Life360: 
  
 Alertas de Locais: veja quando seus amigos e familiares voltam para casa da escola, saem do trabalho ou começam a treinar. Os Alertas de Locais vão mantê-lo informado quando você estiver ocupado com suas tarefas. 
  
Histórico de Localização: consulte uma linha do tempo contínua das idas e vindas do seu Círculo, organizada por dia. Verifique facilmente viagens anteriores e até mesmo quanto tempo cada um dos membros passa em locais específicos.
  
Alerta de SOS: sinta-se protegido com os Alertas de SOS. Se você se sentir inseguro ou tiver uma emergência, o SOS enviará um alerta de ajuda silencioso com sua localização para seu Círculo e seus contatos de emergência.
  
Notificação de Bateria Fraca: o Life360 mostra o nível de bateria de cada membro do Círculo e alerta quando a bateria está fraca, para que você fique tranquilo e eles possam carregá-la. 

Relatórios Individuais de Condução: incentive a direção segura revisando o histórico de viagens de cada motorista todas as semanas. Verifique alta velocidade, uso do celular, freagem brusca e aceleração rápida. Além disso, confira a pontuação de condução e descubra quem é o motorista mais prudente do seu Círculo. 
  
Atualize para o Life360 premium e desbloqueie ainda mais recursos:

Versão Silver:
- 7 dias de Histórico de Localização
- Configure até 5 Lugares com Alertas Ilimitados
- Alertas Premium para Detecção de Acidentes e SOS
- Atendimento Prioritário ao Cliente
- Além disso, tudo incluso na versão Gratuita

Versão Gold:
- 30 dias de Histórico de Localização
- Lugares Ilimitados com Alertas Ilimitados
- Relatórios de Motoristas Individuais e Familiares
- Experiência Sem Anúncios
- Além disso, tudo incluso nas versões Gratuita e Silver

Baixe o Life360 agora e tenha paz de espírito, sabendo que seus entes queridos estão seguros e seus objetos de valor estão protegidos. Fique conectado com as pessoas que mais importam — junte-se a milhões que confiam no Life360 para todas as suas necessidades de compartilhamento de localização.

https://www.life360.com/privacy_policy/
https://www.life360.com/terms_of_use/

Aviso Legal: O uso contínuo de serviços de compartilhamento de localização enquanto o aplicativo está em segundo plano pode drenar excessivamente a bateria. Mas não se preocupe, passamos 10 anos desenvolvendo nossa tecnologia de localização e nossos algoritmos sempre mantêm o uso da bateria no mínimo, mesmo enquanto você dirige!

name: X
description:
Bem-vindo ao X, anteriormente conhecido como Twitter, sua praça digital confiável onde as conversas se desenrolam em tempo real e o mundo se conecta por meio de notícias de última hora, eventos ao vivo, podcasts e tudo mais.

Seja você apaixonado por esportes, tecnologia, música ou política, o X é o seu lugar na primeira fila para o que está acontecendo no mundo todo.

O X não é apenas mais um app de rede social, é o destino definitivo para se manter bem informado, compartilhar ideias e construir comunidades. Com o X, você sempre fica por dentro dos tópicos em alta e das notícias de última hora, entregues instantaneamente na sua tela, cruas e sem filtros.

O que você pode fazer no X:
• Acompanhe notícias de última hora do mundo todo antes de elas virarem manchete e fique à frente com atualizações em tempo real sobre tópicos em alta e conversas virais.
• Poste seus pensamentos, fotos e vídeos com uma comunidade global. Junte-se a milhões de usuários para moldar o diálogo público em conversas sociais, culturais e políticas.
• Descubra o Grok, o assistente de IA alimentado por dados em tempo real do X. Você pode pedir ao Grok para resumir notícias em alta, explicar vídeos ou dar mais contexto sobre posts.
• Transmita vídeo ao vivo ou entre ao vivo com Spaces, nosso recurso de áudio que permite hospedar discussões, fazer entrevistas ou iniciar seu próximo podcast ao vivo. Seja transmitindo um show, um jogo ao vivo ou suas opiniões sobre um tópico quente, o X mantém sua audiência engajada.
• Assista a vídeos: de notícias de última hora ao vivo e clipes de esportes a podcasts e sessões de jogos que duram até 3 horas. Muitas das vozes líderes mundiais em comédia, jogos, podcasts e política compartilham seu conteúdo no X.
• Conecte-se e converse em particular com amigos, seguidores, clientes ou colaboradores por meio de Mensagens Diretas.
• Participe e crie comunidades personalizadas para seus interesses: de notícias de esportes, jogos, entretenimento, cripto, empreendedorismo, tecnologia e mais.
• Assine o X Premium para desbloquear recursos exclusivos, como o selo azul, visibilidade ampliada, respostas priorizadas, menos anúncios, vídeos mais longos e edição de posts. O X Premium também dá acesso ao compartilhamento de receita para criadores e a capacidade de oferecer conteúdo exclusivo para assinantes.

Por que o X?
Em um mundo de mudanças constantes, o X é sua fonte em tempo real para ficar à frente, se conectar com pessoas e explorar perspectivas diversas. De notícias de última hora ao vivo e memes em alta a podcasts de ponta e transmissões ao vivo dos seus criadores favoritos, o X reúne tudo em uma experiência social poderosa.

name: Tinder - app de relacionamento
description:
TUDO COMEÇA COM UM MATCH.

Com mais de 97 bilhões de matches até hoje, o Tinder® é o principal app gratuito de relacionamentos e o melhor lugar pra conhecer gente nova, com recursos de segurança que te ajudam a ir a dates de forma mais segura. Procurando um amor verdadeiro? Um relacionamento aberto? Um date? Novas amizades? Com o Tinder, você pode conhecer pessoas em qualquer lugar e aproveitar seus dates ao máximo:

Fotos são legais, mas não são tudo na vida: compartilhe seus interesses e saiba mais sobre seus matches em potencial. Assim fica mais fácil começar um papo.
Encontre o match perfeito: adicione sua intenção de relacionamento para deixar claro o que você procura.

COMO O TINDER FUNCIONA

É fácil e divertido conhecer gente nova no Tinder®. Deixe sua personalidade brilhar e, para aumentar as chances de dar match, use suas melhores fotos (todos querem ver o seu rosto, hein?), fale um pouco sobre você e responda a perguntas. Deslize pra direita para curtir alguém ou pra esquerda para passar. Se alguém curtir seu perfil de volta, deu match! E é tudo sem pressão, viu? O interesse precisa ser mútuo pra dar match.

SEGURANÇA EM PRIMEIRO LUGAR
Teste nossos recursos de segurança para dar matches com mais confiança:

- Compartilhe meu date: compartilhe os planos do seu date com amigos e familiares para que eles saibam com quem você vai se encontrar e onde
- Verificação por foto: verifique seu perfil para ajudar matches em potencial a saber que a pessoa da foto é de verdade e aumente suas chances de dar match
- Você tem certeza/Isso te incomoda?: o Tinder detecta linguagem inadequada para que as pessoas pensem duas vezes antes de enviar uma mensagem ofensiva
- Denuncie um perfil: denuncie e bloqueie perfis com atividade suspeita ou comportamento inadequado rapidamente
- Bloqueie contatos: assuma o controle e bloqueie quem quiser (um ex, por exemplo)
- Videochat: a conversa tá fluindo? Veja se vocês têm química e conheça seu match sem sair de casa!

EXPERIMENTE O TINDER PLUS
- Curtidas ilimitadas para você dar quantos matches quiser
- Use o Modo Passaporte pra dar match e conversar com pessoas locais antes de viajar
- O recurso Voltar ilimitado permite que você volte ao perfil anterior caso mude de ideia
- Use o Modo Anônimo e mostre seu perfil apenas para pessoas que você curtir

EXPERIMENTE O TINDER GOLD
- Todos os recursos do Tinder Plus™ para você testar por uma semana, antes de se comprometer com uma assinatura mensal

Fique perto de amigos e familiares por meio de ligações e conversas em grupo protegidas com a criptografia de ponta a ponta. summary: Launch games, monitor ping & device stats, enable DND, and display in-game HUD.
description:
Organize your game library, monitor real-time device vitals, and minimize distractions with Game Launcher VIP!

Game Launcher VIP is designed as a centralized gaming utility hub. It brings your installed games together in one launcher and provides essential monitoring tools like an in-game HUD, network latency tracking, and a notification silencer for an uninterrupted gaming session.

🎮 Centralized Game Launcher
• Keep all your installed games organized in one clean dashboard.
• Quickly find and launch your favorite games directly without browsing through the app drawer.

📊 Real-Time Device & Hardware Monitor
• Ping / Network Latency: Track your current network latency to evaluate connection stability.
• Memory & Storage Stats: View available vs. total system memory usage.
• Battery & Temperature: Keep track of battery percentage, charging state, and battery temperature to prevent unexpected shutdowns.
• GFX & Display Benchmark: View device display resolution, refresh rate, and graphics capability benchmarks.

🛡️ In-Game Performance HUD Overlay
• Keep an eye on vital statistics while actively playing.
• Floating HUD overlay displays your ping, memory metrics, and battery temperature directly on your screen.

🔕 Gamer Mode (Do Not Disturb)
• Focus on your gameplay without interruptions.
• Automatically silences notifications and calls using system Do Not Disturb (DND) settings when Gamer Mode is enabled.

🌐 Local Game Firewall (On-Device VPN)
• Limit background data usage of other apps while you game.
• Uses Android's local VpnService to restrict internet access exclusively for unlisted background apps, helping protect your gaming bandwidth.

🔒 Permissions & Privacy Transparency
We value your privacy and only request permissions required for core utility features:

• VpnService: Used exclusively to run a local loopback firewall that restricts internet access to unselected background apps. No external VPN server is connected, and no network traffic is logged or sent off your device.
• Notification Policy Access (DND): Required to silence incoming notifications and alerts during Gamer Mode.
• Special Use Foreground Service: Used solely to monitor active network ping and keep the in-game HUD overlay responsive while playing.
• Internet: Used for measuring network latency (ping checks) and serving in-app features.

⚠️ Disclaimer
Gam Launcher VIP is a utility and monitoring suite. This app does not overclock, alter, or physically boost device hardware (CPU, GPU, or RAM). Device performance depends entirely on the specifications and capabilities provided by your device manufacturer.

name: Sensi Pro: Sensitivity & HUD

description:
Sensi Pro is a sensitivity toolkit for mobile shooter players, with a live Game HUD and on-device AI. No root, no extra apps, no ads.

SENSITIVITY FINDER
• Reads your screen size and refresh rate from the phone itself
• Asks how you hold it (2, 3 or 4 fingers) and how you play
• Suggests starting values — and prints every rule it used next to the numbers
Values are a guide you type into your game's own menu. The app never touches a game.

TEST & CALIBRATE
• Three short drills in the app: flick, track a moving ring, micro-adjust
• Measures overshooting, steadiness and precision and turns them into small per-row adjustments; also counts your touch sampling rate
• Shows what changed and why before you apply it

PROFILES & TEMPLATES
• Profile slots: one free, three with VIP — every change saved automatically
• Templates that mirror each game's menu layout: Free Fire-style, PUBG / BGMI-style, COD Mobile-style and a generic layout
• Playstyle and game-mode presets for each template
• Share a profile as a code or QR and import a friend's — offline, no account
• Bind a profile to a game (VIP): launching that game from Sensi Pro selects it

GAME HUD
A floating panel with four tabs:
• LIVE: ping, refresh rate (Hz) and battery temperature as gauges, thresholds printed beside them
• CHART: your last 60 real ping samples, the jitter band and the AI's next-ping estimate
• PHONE: Focus (Do Not Disturb), keep-awake, dim, screenshot and screen recording, plus thermal status, battery, free RAM and throughput
• MY GAMES: your games one tap away, with the previous session's numbers
Drag it anywhere, shrink it to a ping bubble or close it. A REC line shows how much of the session is recorded.

AUTO (VIP)
• Auto HUD: opens the HUD when a game from your list comes to the front and closes it after you leave — needs Usage Access, which only tells the app which app is in front
• Auto setup on launch: Focus, screen awake and dim, all undone when the HUD closes
• AI alerts when ping or jitter runs above your usual for that game, both numbers shown

PRE-GAME TOOLS
• Device Scan: one tap measures live ping, battery temperature, free RAM and refresh rate into one report — it changes no setting
• Focus Mode: turns on Do Not Disturb for the match and lifts it when you return

ON-DEVICE AI
• AI network forecast: a small model learns from your real ping history to estimate the next latency and rate its stability
• AI Game Coach: add your games, launch them from Sensi Pro and get per-game insights — sessions, play time this week, typical ping and tips; a detail screen shows what it learned
Both models run entirely on your phone; your ping and play history never leave it.

MORE TOOLS
• GFX Guide: graphics values suggested for your phone's RAM, cores and real refresh rates — you apply them in your game's own settings
• Home screen widget and per-game shortcuts: one tap opens the game with the HUD
• Break reminder, weekly play time and a report after each HUD session
• English, Tiếng Việt, Bahasa Indonesia, ไทย, Bahasa Melayu, हिन्दी, Português, Español

VIP (optional subscription)
Auto HUD, auto setup, AI alerts, screen recording, the sensitivity converter (a profile onto another template or screen size), profile slots 2 and 3, per-game profiles and the AI Game Coach for unlimited games. Prices are shown before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage or cancel anytime in Google Play → Subscriptions.

IMPORTANT
Sensi Pro is a configuration and measurement utility. It does NOT read, modify or interact with any game or its files, draws nothing over other apps except the optional Game HUD readout, injects no code and provides no automatic aiming. Template names only describe each game's own menu layout; game names are trademarks of their owners and this app is not affiliated with or endorsed by any game. name: Game Mode Pro: Launcher & HUD
summary: Launch your games, watch live device readings, get a report after every session.
description:
Game Mode Pro is the paid edition of Game Mode: the same launcher and device-reading tools, its own interface, and no ads of any kind.

GAME LAUNCHER
Keep your games in one place. Apps that declare themselves as games are picked up automatically; anything else you add by hand. A home screen widget carries your most played game and the minute it usually dips.

LIVE HUD OVER YOUR GAME
With your permission, a small floating panel shows what Android reports while you play: free RAM, battery level and temperature, latency to a public DNS server, screen refresh rate. It does not show in-game FPS - no app can measure another app's frame rate - and it does not change how your game runs. Prefer no panel? Put one number in a screen corner instead.

REMINDERS WHILE YOU PLAY
Optional notifications, one of each per session: the minute your sessions with that game usually start to wobble, a hot battery, a low one, a phone already hot on the charger.

A REPORT AFTER EVERY SESSION
When you finish, the session's readings become a report: ping stability, free memory and battery temperature with the raw numbers beside each score, plus playing time. Every session is kept, and every game's play history is there to read.

AI GAME COACH - LEARNED FROM YOUR OWN SESSIONS
A model that runs entirely on your phone reads the sessions the HUD recorded: the minute your sessions with a game usually start to wobble, how long you can play before that, how long the battery lasts at that game's drain, and the time of day and network they held up best on. Behind it sit a risk-per-minute curve and a side-by-side of which game runs steadiest, gets hottest and drains fastest. Two recorded sessions of one game are enough for it to start. Nothing leaves your phone. These are predictions from your own history, not guarantees, and the app does not change your game or your device.

NETWORK CHECK
Twenty round-trip measurements to a public DNS server, one per second, with per-second bars, the average, the lowest, the variation and how many went unanswered. It measures your connection, it cannot change it, and never reaches a game's server.

GFX GUIDE
From your device's RAM, CPU cores, resolution and refresh rate, the app suggests a starting point for graphics, frame rate, resolution and shadows - settings you apply in the game yourself. The app cannot change a game's settings or make it run faster.

GAME MODE
Silences notifications while you play (your previous Do Not Disturb setting comes back afterwards) and, if you choose, calls too. It can also hold screen brightness where it is, set your media volume, keep the screen awake while Game HUD is on, and remind you to take a break. Auto Game Mode switches it on when a game opens and off when you leave. Everything it changes is restored when Game Mode ends; the brightness lock asks for "Modify system settings" with an explanation.

BEFORE YOU START
Opening a game from the launcher checks free memory, battery temperature and free storage against thresholds and names any reading outside them, instead of always saying "ready".

REFLEX TRAINER
Two short drills between matches: tap the instant the panel turns green, or hit twelve targets as fast as you can. Timed from the frame change to your touch - it measures you, not the device.

VIP (optional subscription)
Six things your recorded sessions make possible: a forecast of how the next session is likely to go; how much longer this game runs on the battery you have now; alerts that learn what is normal for your phone; how it has changed since your first sessions; a backup of your session log, so it survives a reinstall or a new phone; and your records with a weekly report. Everything else above is in the purchase price.

In 10 languages, switchable inside the app. Permissions: "Display over other apps" and "Usage access" are only needed for the HUD, and the app asks for them on the HUD screen with an explanation. Notification policy access is only for Game Mode's Do Not Disturb.

Download MINIMAA and start your digital detox today.

—

Accessibility Service API Usage

MINIMAA includes optional features—Focus & Gestures (App & Web Blocking,
navigation shortcuts, and Double Tap to Lock)—that utilize Android's
Accessibility Service API.

When enabled, this service performs the following functions:
• Web Detox & App Blocking: Reads the active application package name and
  browser URL address bar in real-time to detect when a user-defined
  distracting app or website is opened and displays a focus prompt to block
  access.
• Navigation & System Actions: Receives gesture triggers (like double-tapping
  on the home screen or executing motion shortcuts) to perform corresponding
  system actions, such as locking your screen or going Back/Home.

Privacy and Data Safety:
• No Data Collection: The service only reads the active app package name and
  the browser's address bar to determine if a block is triggered. It does not
  record keystrokes, personal details, or other screen content.
• No Data Transmission: No accessed data is stored, collected, or
  transmitted. All processing happens locally on your device.
• Fully Optional: These features are completely optional. The Accessibility
  Service is not enabled by default and can be turned off at any time in
  Android system settings.

MINIMAA is not an accessibility tool for users with disabilities.

name: CNH do Brasil
summary: Digital driver's license and vehicle registration certificate, first driver's license, traffic violation and vehicle information.
description:
The Brazilian CNH app is the evolution of the Digital Traffic Wallet (CDT), which started as the Digital CNH. With the app, you can access your digital documents - National Driver's License (CNH) and Vehicle Registration and Licensing Certificate (CRLV) - in a practical and secure way, directly from your cell phone.

In addition, those who are not yet licensed can start the process of obtaining their First Driver's License through the app itself, making everything simpler and more accessible.

The Digital CNH and the Digital CRLV are the digital versions of the National Driver's License (CNH) and the Vehicle Registration and Licensing Certificate (CRLV) with the same legal value as their respective printed versions.

The digital versions offer additional advantages that provide greater mobility, practicality and convenience through:

- Ease of sharing information (export to PDF with digital signature in the ICP-Brasil standard with legal validity according to MP 2.200-2/2001). This avoids printing and/or scanning documents, as well as eliminating the need for notarization;

- Have your authenticity, reliability, and integrity easily validated through the Vio app. To do this, simply download the Vio app and point the reader at the QR Code of your digital document.

For more information, visit:

Frequently Asked Questions:

https://portalservicos.senatran.serpro.gov.br/#/ajuda/faq/cnh-do-brasil

name: Telegram
summary: Telegram is a messaging app with a focus on speed and security.
description:
Pure instant messaging — simple, fast, secure, and synced across all your devices. One of the top 5 most downloaded apps in the world with over 1 billion active users.

FAST: Telegram is the fastest messaging app on the market, connecting people via a unique, distributed network of data centers around the globe.

SYNCED: You can access your messages from all your phones, tablets and computers at once. Telegram apps are standalone, so you don’t need to keep your phone connected. Start typing on one device and finish the message from another. Never lose your data again.

UNLIMITED: You can send media and files, without any limits on their type and size. Your entire chat history will require no disk space on your device, and will be securely stored in the Telegram cloud for as long as you need it. 

SECURE: We made it our mission to provide the best security combined with ease of use. Everything on Telegram, including chats, groups, media, etc. is encrypted using a combination of 256-bit symmetric AES encryption, 2048-bit RSA encryption, and Diffie–Hellman secure key exchange. 

100% FREE & OPEN: Telegram has a fully documented and free API for developers, open source apps and verifiable builds to prove the app you download is built from the exact same source code that is published. 

POWERFUL: You can create group chats with up to 200,000 members, share large videos, documents of any type (.DOCX, .MP3, .ZIP, etc.) up to 2 GB each, and even set up bots for specific tasks. Telegram is the perfect tool for hosting online communities and coordinating teamwork.

RELIABLE: Built to deliver your messages using as little data as possible, Telegram is the most reliable messaging system ever made. It works even on the weakest mobile connections. 

FUN: Telegram has powerful photo and video editing tools, animated stickers and emoji, fully customizable themes to change the appearance of your app, and an open sticker/GIF platform to cater to all your expressive needs.

SIMPLE: While providing an unprecedented array of features, we take great care to keep the interface clean. Telegram is so simple you already know how to use it.

PRIVATE: We take your privacy seriously and will never give any third parties access to your data. You can delete any message you ever sent or received for both sides, at any time and without a trace. Telegram will never use your data to show you ads.

For those interested in maximum privacy, Telegram offers Secret Chats. Secret Chat messages can be programmed to self-destruct automatically from both participating devices. This way you can send all types of disappearing content — messages, photos, videos, and even files. Secret Chats use End-to-End Encryption to ensure that a message can only be read by its intended recipient.

We keep expanding the boundaries of what you can do with a messaging app. Don’t wait years for older messengers to catch up with Telegram — join the revolution today.

- Check your status in the People's Gas Program.

- Check the main access criteria: be registered in the Cadastro Único (CadÚnico) with updated data, be a beneficiary of Bolsa Família with two or more people in the family group, have a monthly per capita income equal to or less than half the minimum wage, and keep the CPF of the Family Head regularized.

- Understand the importance of keeping your data always updated to avoid pending issues or cancellation of the benefit.

Download Meu Social - Gás do Povo and track your Gás do Povo Program benefits quickly, securely, and transparently — directly on your cell phone.

Important note on security:
Always remember to check if the application you are downloading is an official Federal Government app.

To do this, follow these tips:
In app stores, check if the app has the "Government" seal, displayed next to the ratings — it indicates that the app has been verified by Google Play as belonging to a government entity. Verify that the developer is “Serviços e Informações do Brasil”, the official account that brings together the applications of the Federal Public Administration on Gov.br.

These measures help you avoid fake apps and ensure that you are using a secure and legitimate app from the Federal Government.

Spoke Route Planner works in almost every country because it uses location data provided by Google Maps. If Google Maps works where you live, then Spoke Route Planner will work for you. We have users in over 190 countries and on every continent.

Spoke will automatically use your phone language if it is supported. If it is not, it will default to US English.

You can have unlimited routes on the free and paid version of Spoke Route Planner.

name: 157 Grau: Online RP
summary: Brazilian open world game with Grau, vehicle customization and lots of action.
description:
This Brazilian open-world game offers an immersive and engaging experience, inspired by the country's urban culture. In a large city scenario, the player has complete freedom to explore busy streets, favelas and diverse neighborhoods, while participating in challenging missions and interacting with a rich narrative full of twists and turns.

The game mechanics allow the player to perform motorcycle "degrees", popular street maneuvers and automotive events, ensuring an authentic experience faithful to Brazilian street culture. There are dozens of motorcycle models, from the popular to the most powerful, all with the possibility of customization. The vehicle customization system goes far beyond aesthetics, allowing the modification of colors, stickers, parts and even performance adjustments, such as suspension and turbo, for those looking for speed on the tracks.

In addition to motorcycles, cars also feature heavily in the game, with the possibility of customizing iconic and popular vehicles in Brazil. Every detail is thought out so that players can create a car or motorcycle that reflects their style and personality, from different wheels to the powerful sound system, perfect for those who like to parade through the streets.

The city is alive and full of activities, from racing disputes on deserted avenues to crime-fighting missions, where the player can choose his path, being an outlaw or someone who seeks his own justice. The faction and gang system offers social dynamics, where it is possible to create alliances, conquer territories and engage in intense rivalries, ensuring that each player's decision has an impact on the narrative.

With high-quality graphics, a soundtrack filled with funk, rap and pagoda, as well as a customizable radio system, the game immerses players in an authentic environment, where every corner brings a new adventure. Realistic bike and car physics combined with a detailed environment ensure that every maneuver, whether it's a perfect grade or a quick getaway, has a realistic and exciting feel.

This game is not just about action and speed; he also explores life in large Brazilian cities, addressing themes such as friendship, loyalty and the difficulties faced by those who live on the outskirts. It is a journey that combines the adrenaline of chases and shootouts with moments of reflection, offering a unique open-world experience deeply connected to the Brazilian reality.

Built from the ground up for mobile-first PvP, Wild Rift is a 5v5 multiplayer online battle arena (MOBA) game with exciting action where your skills, strategy, and combat senses are put to the test.

Wild Rift is packed with content and fresh features for the ultimate PvP multiplayer experience. Enjoy fast-paced MOBA combat, real-time strategy, smooth controls, and diverse 5v5 gameplay. Team up with friends, lock in your champion, and play to win! Play together in a thrilling team battle where you test your combat prowess to see who comes out on top.

Competitive 5v5 battles await in League of Legends: Wild Rift. Dive into exciting PvP battles with casual or ranked mode to level up your champions and unlock powerful abilities. Experience a mobile  adventure like no other with multiplayer online gameplay, competitive matches, and the epic MOBA experience you’ve come to know and love from League of Legends.

Download League of Legends: Wild Rift today and lead your team to victory!

OUTPLAY, OUTSMART, OUTSKILL
-   A true MOBA game where your strategy and skills are put to the test.
- Unranked and ranked mode where every champion, item, and objective can be the key to victory.
- Real-time multiplayer games powered by skill shots, team fights, and big plays.

REAL-TIME BATTLES WITH FRIENDS
- Team up with friends and test your skills in MOBA combat!
- 5v5 online multiplayer games where teamwork can be the difference between shutdowns and shutouts.
- Join games  as a duo, trio, or a full team of five and climb the ladder one enemy Nexus at a time.
- Face off in the arena, join a guild, and play together with friends to earn exclusive rewards.

UNIQUE CHAMPIONS AND ABILITIES
- Play a different champion or master your favorites each game: take over the Rift with champions that fit your playstyle.
- Choose from a roster of melee, ranged, magic, or attack-damage champions.
- Queue up as a carry, support, jungler, or tank in competitive 5v5 battles!

PREMIUM MOBILE MOBA EXPERIENCE
- Perfect for both casual and hardcore mobile gamers who love exhilarating online multiplayer games.
- PvP arena battles with vibrant style, beautiful graphics, and memorable characters.
- Multiple game modes, champions, and cosmetics that are constantly updated.
- The mobile-optimized 5v5 battle arena gameplay of League of Legends.
- Never a dull moment, with ever-changing, high-quality content.

FREE TO PLAY, FAIR TO PLAY
- Balanced MOBA gameplay that prioritizes player skill in 5v5 combat.
- A PvP action experience that’s always free-to-play, with no way to pay for power or playtime. Ever.
- Earn every champion for free just by playing—no “purchase only” champions.
- Adapt styles and innovate team compositions for tactical choices that fit your style.

name: Clash Royale
summary: Battle to defend your tower in this real-time multiplayer PvP card strategy game
description:
ALL FOR THE CROWN!

Build a formidable team, attack enemy towers, and use strategy skills to defend your own in multiplayer PvP card battles. Unlock 100+ unique cards, build an unrivalled battle deck, and defend your King’s Tower using strategy, wit, and Skeletons.

Clash Royale is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money (including random items). If you don't want to purchase game items for real money, please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings.

Work on your tower defense strategy to protect the King. Use careful card placement in every battle to win multiplayer PvP matches and stop your castle tower from falling. Build your card deck and develop a strategy to give you the advantage in every multiplayer PvP battle.

Battle in multiplayer PvP card strategy matches with players all over the world. Unlock new characters and use Evo Shards to make your card deck more powerful. Take down enemy towers…but don’t forget to defend your own!

BUILD DECKS, BATTLE, WIN!
Enter the Arena! Build your Battle Deck and outsmart the enemy in fast-paced multiplayer PvP tower defense card battles. From the creators of CLASH OF CLANS, starring your favorite Clash® characters and more. 

BECOME A MASTER OF STRATEGY & DEFEND YOUR TOWERS
Choose unique cards for your Battle Deck and head to the Arena for multiplayer PvP card games!
Hone your strategy: place your Cards right and knock the enemy King and Princesses from their towers in fast-paced PvP battles—just make sure you remember to defend your own Tower.

COLLECT CARDS, BUILD YOUR STRATEGY
Hog Rider! Collect and upgrade 100+ cards featuring the Clash of Clans troops, spells and defences you know and love. Use strategy to defend your towers, win multiplayer PvP card battle games and progress to new Arenas to unlock powerful new cards for your collection!

BATTLE YOUR WAY TO THE TOP
Defend your Towers, hone your strategy, and upgrade your cards to battle your way to the multiplayer PvP League games and Global Tournaments! Match against the best players in the world and compete in multiplayer PvP card battles for glory and rewards!

SEASONAL EVENTS
Unlock new items like Tower Skins, Emotes, and powerful Magic Items to use in multiplayer PvP battles with the season pass – and participate in fun challenges that put your card battle skills to the test!

JOIN A CLAN AND GO TO WAR
Join or form a Clan with other players to share cards, and battle in multiplayer PvP Clan Wars and card games for BIG rewards!

Build your card battle deck, hone your strategy, defend your towers, and get ready to clash! See you in the battle Arena!

name: Total Battle: Strategy Games
summary: Conquer kingdoms and lead heroes to victory in strategic war battles!
description:
Are you ready for epic battles?

Total Battle is free to download and play, however, it contains in-app purchases, including random-item purchases.

Build your empire and prepare for war with Total Battle, a multiplayer war strategy game that pits you against enemy factions across ancient civilizations, magic kingdoms and great empires.

Become immersed in your own world while battling for glory. Enjoy this multiplayer online strategy building game and show off your castle defense skills and tactical war strategies. Command and conquer kingdoms and castles, occupy forts, and feel the rush in this fantasy MMO RTS 4X game.

Battle alongside legendary heroes who’ll defend their territory at all costs and wage war against monsters, barbarians, wizards, elves, and other foes. Build a base and establish a strong tower defense strategy to win all the king’s battles in this medieval strategy war game and become the Lord of all the Kingdoms!

BUILD YOUR EMPIRE & DEFEND YOURSELF IN TIMES OF WAR
● Build a base for your military, which lies at the heart of your castle
● Progress from guardsmen with basic weapons to warriors and additional troops, including titans, dragons, elementals, and other fantastic beasts 
● Defend your empire, eliminate enemy troops, and conquer the world on your behalf
● Summon the best captains to lead your warriors and achieve victory 
● Your skills as an empire-builder will determine the future, so do your best
● Strategy games require you to make the right choices for managing the troops in your army—each unit has unique abilities for going to war against monsters and other players
● Dozens of types of magic enemies of different levels


WAR STRATEGY GAMES & MULTIPLAYER BATTLES
● An MMO 4X real-time strategy game with PvE and PvP modes
● A massive open world with hundreds of kingdoms and millions of lords' castles
● Play alongside dozens of legendary heroes and captains from different civilizations online
● Find unique points of interest on the world map among deserts, forests, and mountain ranges
● Battle through hordes of enemies, abandoned gold mines, battle arenas, and ancient crypts filled with treasure that are just waiting to be discovered! 
● Not every strategy will win you a war! Dedication, careful planning, and good management will. Build a strong empire and raise a civilization
● Compete in regular competitions and challenges, putting your skills to the test

RPG MECHANICS TO BOLSTER YOUR ARMY
● Enhance your tactics with an RPG-style character leveling system
● Your heroes and captains have various skills for dealing with different situations. 
● Craft equipment and level up your heroes just like in the best MMORPGs. 
● Put your heroes at the head of your legion of troops, earn XP, and win wars!

CALL ON YOUR DRAGON
● Accept the challenge of epic monsters and raise your dragon 
● Give him a name and summon him to fight against your most dangerous enemies 
● The strength of your dragon will be indispensable when besieging mighty magical citadels

BATTLE ONLINE & JOIN CLANS
● Battle and play online with different clans
● Play with users from all over the world and fight for battle glory.
● Join a clan of like-minded people, play with friends, and achieve your goals together in this online 4X strategy game.
● Capture territory, climb to the top of the war rankings, and enlist the support of thousands of allies to help you achieve world domination

Total Battle is a war strategy game with various historical epochs: from ancient times to medieval and then to the age of discovery. Join the online battle strategy game, build an empire, and win!

name: Genshin Impact 6th Anniversary
summary: Explore a World of Adventure
description:
This game includes optional in-game purchases, including random virtual items.

Step into Teyvat, a vast world teeming with life and flowing with elemental energy.

You and your sibling arrived here from another world. Separated by an unknown god, stripped of your powers, and cast into a deep slumber, you now awake to a world very different from when you first arrived.

Thus begins your journey across Teyvat to seek answers from The Seven — the gods of each element. Along the way, prepare to explore every inch of this wondrous world, join forces with a diverse range of characters, and unravel the countless mysteries that Teyvat holds...

MASSIVE OPEN WORLD

Climb any mountain, swim across any river, and glide over the world below, taking in the jaw-dropping scenery each step of the way. And if you stop to investigate a wandering Seelie or strange mechanism, who knows what you might discover?

ELEMENTAL COMBAT SYSTEM

Harness the seven elements to unleash elemental reactions. Anemo, Electro, Hydro, Pyro, Cryo, Dendro, and Geo interact in all sorts of ways, and Vision wielders have the power to turn this to their advantage.

Will you vaporize Hydro with Pyro, electro-charge it with Electro, or freeze it with Cryo? Your mastery of the elements will give you the upper hand in battle and exploration.

BEAUTIFUL VISUALS

Feast your eyes on the world around you, with a stunning art style, real-time rendering, and finely tuned character animations delivering you a truly immersive visual experience. Lighting and weather all change naturally over time, bringing every detail of this world to life.

SOOTHING SOUNDTRACK

Let the beautiful sounds of Teyvat draw you in as you explore the expansive world around you. Performed by the world's top orchestras such as London Philharmonic Orchestra and Shanghai Symphony Orchestra, the soundtrack changes seamlessly with the time and gameplay to match the mood.

BUILD YOUR DREAM TEAM

Team up with a diverse cast of characters in Teyvat, each with their own unique personalities, stories, and abilities. Discover your favorite party combinations and level up your characters to help you conquer even the most daunting of enemies and domains.

JOURNEY WITH FRIENDS

Team up with friends across various platforms to trigger more elemental action, tackle tricky boss fights, and conquer challenging domains together to reap rich rewards.

As you stand atop the peaks of Jueyun Karst and take in the rolling clouds and vast terrain stretching out before you, you may wish to stay in Teyvat a little longer... But until you are reunited with your lost sibling, how can you rest? Go forth, Traveler, and begin your adventure!

WANDER THE THOUSAND STARS, SHAPE MYRIADS OF WONDERLANDS

Enter Miliastra Wonderland — a dreamlike realm of adventure, creation, and socializing. Customize your Manekins, meet friends in the Lobby, tackle challenges in various stages, or craft your own unique worlds in the Miliastra Sandbox!

SUPPORT
If you encounter any issues during the game, you can send us feedback via the in-game Customer Service Center.

What if ancient China and ancient Rome went to war? When Julius Caesar clashes with Cao Cao on the same battlefield, who shall emerge victorious?
What does it feel like to play a war strategy game that fuses MOBA and RTS mechanics, featuring multiplayer competition and real-time combat?
What stories will unfold in a vast world shared by over 80,000 players, free to explore, gather, create, build, and battle?
Find the answer in Rise of Kingdoms, a battlefield unlike anything you have experienced before.

▶FEATURES◀
15 Unique Civilizations
Choose one of 15 historical civilizations and guide your empire from a lone clan into a great, unstoppable force! Each civilization has its own architecture, unique units, and special advantages — how you utilize them is up to you!

Real-Time Battles
Battles happen in real time on the map. Anyone can join or leave a battle at any time, allowing true RTS gameplay. See an ally being attacked right in your backyard? Send some troops to help your buddy out, or launch a surprise counterattack on the attacker’s city.

Seamless World Map
All in-game action takes place on a single, enormous map inhabited by players and NPCs. No isolated bases or separate battle screens. Never before seen on mobile “infinite zoom” allows you to transition freely between the world view and individual cities or barbarian outposts. Map features include natural obstructions such as rivers and mountain ranges and strategic passes that must be captured to gain entrance to neighboring regions.

Exploration & Investigation
Your world is covered in thick fog. Dispatch scouts to explore this mysterious land and uncover the hidden treasure within.
Investigate lost temples, barbarian fortresses, mysterious caves, and tribal villages, gather intelligence on your enemies, and prepare yourself for the ultimate battle!

Unrestricted Troop Movements
New orders can be issued to troops at any time, offering limitless strategic possibilities. Launch an attack on an enemy city, then circle back and meet up with your alliance army to capture a pass.
Dispatch troops to collect lumber from a nearby forest and have them pick off a few barbarian clans along the way. Forces can also be split up between multiple commanders so that you can engage in multiple actions simultaneously.

Alliance System
Full alliance features allow players to help one another: live chat with built-in translation, officer roles, map indicators to coordinate strategies, and more! Alliances can expand their territory to gain resources, capture mountain passes and barbarian outposts to strengthen their position, and work together to unlock group achievements.

Conquer the Kingdom
Fight alongside your alliance to take control of this vast kingdom. Clash with other players and use superior tactics to emerge victorious in a MMO strategy battle royale. Rise to the top and you and your civilization will be written down in your kingdom’s history!

RPG Commanders
Call upon dozens of historical figures who will serve as your trustworthy commanders, from Julius Caesar and Sun Tzu to Joan of Arc and Kusunoki Masashige. Level up your commanders by defeating barbarians and sending them into battles, then upgrade their abilities using an RPG style talent tree and skill system.

name: Oxide: Survival Island
summary: Multiplayer survival simulator on abandoned island: survival action with friends
description:
Oxide: Survival Island is a hard online survival simulator. It is a sandbox world with real players. You wake up on a dangerous shore with nothing. This is island survival. Cold, hunger, animals, and enemies can kill you fast. Every server is a shared world. It keeps running even when you leave.

Play on your own servers. Your progress is saved. You can return later and continue. One server can host many players. That makes the world feel alive. You will meet builders, raiders, and clans. You can fight them or work with them. This is a true massively multiplayer survival experience. Many players look for rust survival vibes on mobile. This game gives that tense loop: gather, craft, build, defend, repeat.

Explore a big island of survival. Go through woods and coastal areas. Travel along the ocean and shore. Visit the gas station and enemy bases. Search loot barrels for supplies. The map is larger and more open. It gives you space to hide, scout, and attack. It also gives enemies more places to ambush you. Each run can feel like a lost island story.

You can play solo. You can also play with others. Try multiplayer survival games with friends. Invite them to the same server. Add them to your friends list. See when they are online. This makes teamwork simple. Build together and protect each other. That is co-op survival. If you like coop survival games, you can share roles. One player farms resources. One crafts weapons. One scouts and guards the base. These are coop survival games built by real players. For many fans, it feels like rust survival multiplayer, but designed for phones.

Collect wood, stone, and metal. Craft tools and gear. Craft weapons and ammo. The game has many weapon types. The crafting system is improved. The building system is improved too. Start with a small shelter. Turn it into a strong base. Place walls, doors, and storage. Create a safe area and defend it.

Use the cupboard system to protect your base. Craft a cupboard and place it inside. Put logs in it often. This slows down decay. It also helps you keep control of your home area. Without it, your house will weaken over time.

Survive in three biomes. Some zones are cold. Some are temperate. Some are hot. Craft attire for protection. Clothing helps against damage. It also helps against cold. Watch your food and water. Hunt animals for meat. Cook and store supplies. Manage your inventory and plan long trips.

Travel by land and by sea. The ocean is not only scenery. It is part of the danger and the route. Fans of sea adventure games will enjoy moving along the coast. You can scout bases from the water. You can move loot between points. The sea can also hide enemies. Storms and long routes add pressure. This is where island survival feels the most tense.

Fight for resources. Defend your base. Raid other bases. Make allies if you want. Betrayal is possible too. Each server becomes a contest for control. This is last survival. Only the strongest teams last. Master land survival, learn the map, and get better gear. Build smart, craft fast, and stay alert.

If you search for rust mobile, you want a tough survival sandbox on your phone. If you search for rust in mobile, you want raids, bases, and real players. Oxide brings that style with persistent servers, crafting, and open-world fights. It is a mobile answer for rust survival, with the freedom of a sandbox and the pressure of multiplayer survival.

Enjoy improved sky graphics and day-night changes. Watch the horizon, track threats, and survive the island.

name: Butcher Hero: Monster Idle RPG
summary: Hook monsters in the sand, earn XP, upgrade gear and grow in an idle action RPG.
description:
Enter Butcher Hero, an idle action RPG where every enemy becomes fuel for your next upgrade. Explore hostile sand zones, throw your chain hook, pull monsters and aliens into range, earn XP, and devour their power to build a stronger hero.

Hook, devour, grow

Aim the hook, drag in your target, and finish the fight. Each hunt earns XP and turns captured power into permanent upgrades for damage, attack speed, armor, or health. Choose what to improve and shape a build that can survive tougher zones.

Build your RPG hero

Collect gear and tune your loadout for the challenge ahead. Combine equipment with permanent stats, unlock new ways to fight, and upgrade your hero as enemies become stronger. Make meaningful build choices and keep leveling up.

If you enjoy RPG games and progression-focused adventure games, every hunt gives you a clear upgrade choice and a stronger build to take into the next fight.

Action and idle progression

Butcher Hero combines the quick decisions of action games with the steady growth of idle games. Fans of incremental games can start a short hunt, improve permanent stats, and push into a harder zone. Every choice moves your build forward.

Keep building your hero with AFK progression, or use auto-battle when you want a lighter session. Return to choose upgrades, tune your gear, and decide how to tackle the next fight.

Monster survival in the sand

Push through sand-covered areas filled with creatures, elite enemies, and dangerous aliens. Fans of survival games can focus on armor and health, while aggressive builds lean into damage and speed. Adapt your loadout and keep moving as every area raises the pressure.

Win boss battles

Face massive bosses with distinct attacks and rising difficulty. Learn each encounter, improve your gear, and return stronger. Climb the Boss Tower to see how far your build can go and earn rewards from demanding boss battles.

Complete quests and claim rewards

Finish quests, gather crystals, and open chests for resources that help your hero grow. Develop the Soul Graph, reinforce your favorite stats, and create a loadout ready for the next challenge.

Play offline or enter PvP

Fans of offline games can play the complete single-player adventure without an internet connection. When connected, test your build against other heroes in PvP battles. PvP is separate from offline single-player play.

Play your way

• Chain-hook combat built around pulling enemies into range
• Devour power and turn every hunt into permanent growth
• Upgrade damage, speed, armor, and health
• Collect gear and customize your loadout
• Fight monsters, aliens, elite enemies, and giant bosses
• Climb the Boss Tower and complete quests
• Earn crystals, open chests, and improve the Soul Graph
• Make progress with AFK progression and optional auto-battle
• Enjoy the complete single-player game offline
• Challenge other heroes in online PvP

Start small, hunt smarter, and become the hero no monster can stop. Hook the enemy, steal its power, upgrade your build, and turn every fight into permanent growth.

name: Sword x Staff
summary: Welcome to the world of Kanstein, where your adventure is what you make it!
description:
Sword x Staff is a one-of-a-kind RPG — a “Third Way RPG.”
Strategy, massive world exploration, idle—why pick one when you can have it all?
Go hardcore, or just vibe—either way, you’ll find your own kind of fun here. The kind that actually feels different.
No pressure, no one way to play—just jump in, explore, and let the adventure click your way.
Curious what the gameplay is really like?
So, welcome to the unique world of Kanstein, and experience the one-of-a-kind Third Way adventure. Here, you are the Chosen Adventurer transported to this isekai! Team up with the Staff and Sword Twins and dive into a quest to save the world. Pierce through thick fog, dig up forgotten treasures, and explore a huge interactive world at your own pace. Mix and match over 200 skills to create a fighting style that’s uniquely yours. Best of all, you’ll meet amazing allies to fight by your side against legendary Hieromons! Of course—Remember, all of this can be enjoyed completely pressure-free, since the idle gameplay making resource gathering a breeze！ 
[Idle Game, but with a massive interactive world] 
Most idle games have you waiting. Sword x Staff lets you actually go somewhere.
Step into a huge world map where every region has its own vibe and secrets to uncover. Roam the lush wilds of Verdantglade, face the clash of steel and instinct in Cinder Ridge, drift through the mist-shrouded waters of Aqualis, and uncover the ancient bronze ruins hidden within Loong Haven.
Every region brings new sights, companions, treasures, and those "just one more look" moments. And even when you're offline, your adventure doesn't stop. Resources keep piling up while you rest, and the Traveling Merchant shows up with rare goods while you're away. Log back in, cash out, and keep going. 
[Deep strategy, but easy to jump in] 
Strategy is fun because of freedom, not because it needs a spreadsheet.
Everything starts with the classic Warrior & Mage dual-class system, branching into 200+ skill combinations and playstyles. Mix skills, change cast order, swap elemental builds, and fine-tune your setup however you like.
No fixed meta. No single "right" answer. Just true variety and real flexibility, and plenty of room to experiment.
Keep it casual, or go full theorycraft mode. How deep you go is completely up to you.
[Progress Without the Grind] 
Power up without the endless farming. Even while you're offline, resources stack up, characters grow stronger, and progression keeps moving.
Lie back, rest up, and wake up stronger! Watch clouds drift across the Floating Islands, stargaze from your cozy cabin, hunt for hidden treasure, or level up while doing absolutely nothing heroic for a minute.
Easy progress, low stress, steady rewards—that's what we call relaxed, efficient progression
[Auto-Battles Are Easy, But Never Boring] 
Tired of idle games where heroes just stand still? Here, AI-driven characters adapt to the battlefield—repositioning, predicting enemies, chasing targets, and unleashing ultimate skills. Auto-battles aren’t boring—they’re tactical, flashy, and full of epic combos.
[Unique avatars, without looking the same] 
Your avatar is yours, full stop. Go bold with wild hairstyles, unusual features, standout looks, or choices that are a little chaotic in the best way. Make something cool, weird, stylish, hilarious—or all four at once! No "same face, different outfit." Make it 100% original. Walk into town and stand out. In Kanstein, being unforgettable is part of the fun.

name: Castle Busters
summary: Real-time 1v1 PvP strategy brawler. Smash castles, siege towers, rule arena!
description:
Castle Busters is a real-time 1v1 PvP strategy game where your castle is your weapon. Draft your units, blast through destructible walls, and crush rival players in fast online multiplayer battles.

No scripted waves. No waiting. Just you, your rival, and a castle that won't survive the match intact.

⚔️ BREAK EVERY WALL. RULE EVERY ARENA.
Your castle isn't just your base, it's your weapon. Every wall you destroy opens a new angle. Every floor you collapse exposes an enemy. In Castle Busters, the battlefield falls apart in real time, and the player who reads it best wins.

WHY PLAYERS LOVE CASTLE BUSTERS

🏰 Fully destructible castles. Blast holes through walls to create firing lines and collapse floors to drop enemy units. No two PvP matches ever play out the same way.
⚡ Real-time 1v1 PvP. Fast online multiplayer matches packed with tactical decisions where every shot counts and every second of hesitation hands your rival a new opening.
🛡️ Build your loadout. Draft up to 8 unique units: knights, archers, bombers and siege engines. Each one changes how you attack, the angles you threaten, and how you defend your keep.
📈 Deep upgrades. Level up units, unlock new perks, and reinforce the parts of your castle that matter most. The longer you play, the sharper your arsenal gets.
🏆 Ranked arenas. Climb from Bronze to Legend and battle real players on seasonal leaderboards.
🔥 The Forge. Earn epic rewards by upgrading your squad and stronghold. The deeper you go, the meaner the meta gets.
🎯 Play your way. Precision snipes, brute-force sieges, decoy walls or collapse traps. Every strategy can win if you execute it right.

CORE GAMEPLAY
Aim and fire from inside your castle using your drafted units. The walls between you and your enemy aren't obstacles, they're opportunities. Destroy supports to collapse towers onto enemy positions. Carve a sightline through three floors to land a shot no one saw coming. Bait your opponent into breaking through where they shouldn't. In Castle Busters, defense is never passive. It's a trap.

Win by wiping out all enemy units, or by turning their castle into rubble. Arena hazards shift your angles and destructible terrain means every PvP battle is a puzzle that builds itself in real time.

DRAFT YOUR ARMY
Knights to break the front line. Archers to punish exposed units. Bombers to crack open walls and towers. Siege engines to flatten whole sections of an enemy castle. Mix and match up to 8 units into a loadout that fits your playstyle: patient and surgical, or fast and chaotic. Then upgrade each unit to unlock power spikes that open entirely new ways to play and clash.

META AND PROGRESSION
Your units grow with you. Level them up to unlock new perks, power spikes and fresh tactical options. Your castle evolves too. Reinforce the walls and towers that matter most, then test your build in multiplayer PvP. From corner deals to the throne
Begin with small trades and tough calls. Make allies, collect favors, and turn tiny wins into real standing. As your influence grows, neighborhoods fall under your control, and each decision opens new chances — and new dangers.

Run the underground supply
Hunt down scarce materials across contested blocks and hide workshops that slowly turn into full operations. Close-up, hands-on lab scenes let you sharpen your product and raise its value on the black market. Improve how you work, bring in trusted hands, and scale from cramped benches to full factories.

Plot dangerous smuggling runs
Plan routes, prepare convoys, and react fast when things break down. Send guarded loads through hostile zones, pick stealth or force, bribe contacts, or sabotage rival narco crews — and always watch for checkpoints. Each successful run opens new trade corridors and extends your reach.

Turn goods into clout
Use distribution to build power: run street deals, land big wholesale contracts, and launder dirty cash into a respectable front. Oversee retail chains, pressure or partner with rivals, and plant investments that keep your empire hidden from view.

Keep the crown — and survive
Power draws betrayal. One mistake can wipe everything out. Recruit loyal lieutenants, sharpen your enforcers, and flush out moles before they strike. Diplomacy, threats, and targeted strikes are all in your playbook — but loyalties can flip overnight. Will you rule from the shadows, or become just another name in a police file?
